headline: Evonik Q3 EBITDA Surges 40% as Company Narrows 2026 Outlook
summary: Evonik posted a 40% jump in third-quarter EBITDA and narrowed its financial outlook for 2026.
why: Significant earnings growth and revised guidance provide investors with clearer visibility into specialty chemical demand and operational cost controls.

impacts.name: Evonik Industries
impacts.why: A 40% increase in EBITDA is a strong positive fundamental driver for equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strongly beating profit expectations with a 40% jump in EBITDA drove positive market reactions.
